## About
Bistagne Bros. Body Shop is a family-owned collision shop on East Chevy Chase Drive in Glendale, serving the Los Angeles community. One reviewer put it simply: it is still very much a family run business, and there are still brothers in the shop.
When your car comes in, we look for all the damage, not just what you can see, so there are no surprises later. We deal with the insurance company and adjusters on your behalf and keep you in the loop the whole way.
From paint and body work to aluminum, frame and electric vehicle repairs, the goal is the same: honest communication, careful work, and a car that comes back right.

## Services
- Estimating: Trained estimators look for all the damage, not just what is visible, so the estimate is accurate and there are no surprises down the road.
- Paint and body repair: Paint and body work done with careful craftsmanship and quality materials.
- Aluminum repair: Aluminum repairs done with specialized tools and dedicated equipment, following manufacturer and industry-approved procedures.
- Unibody and frame repair: Structural and alignment repairs measured to manufacturer specifications on our Car-O-Liner system.
- Electric and hybrid repair: Repairs on electric and hybrid vehicles by technicians with ongoing, model-specific training.
- Paint correction and protection: Paint correction, ceramic coatings and paint protection film to guard against environmental damage and everyday wear.

## FAQ
Q: Will you deal with my insurance company?
A: Yes. From the moment we get your damaged vehicle, we work on your behalf with the insurance company and adjusters to secure approvals for every necessary repair.

Q: Do you work on electric cars like Tesla?
A: Yes. We are equipped to repair electric and hybrid vehicles, and we hold certifications from manufacturers like Tesla and Porsche.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I send a message?
A: We will get back to you within one business day.

I never once felt like I was asking for something they didn't understand and agree with. They also helped identifying and facilitating repair of a couple other existing issues I knew i had with the car, which I really appreciated. Usually when i take my car to a shop, i end up feeling like my level of scrutiny is so much higher than the shop's, that i'm always mildly worried/unhappy at the end. That was never the case here, so I went away feeling very happy about all the work that was done.
The initial repair was an insurance claim, and the office side handled the claim paperwork without me having to do a thing, couldn't have been easier.
